operational.description: Repository availability and observable default-branch automation health.

governance.description: Portfolio review, status-declaration, lifecycle, and repository identity governance checks.

assurance.description: Repository-specific assurance evidence coverage, execution state, provenance and freshness against governed repository revisions.

cross_specification.description: Cross-specification pressure-test evidence is not yet ingested as a portfolio-wide assurance dimension.

findings.subject: dtg-privacy-implementation-profile
findings.claim: A public account repository has no governed account-level portfolio disposition.
findings.recommended_action: Review the repository and assign an explicit included, adjacent, upstream-reference, adapted-upstream-work, historical, unrelated, or pending-review disposition. Discovery never auto-enrols a repository.

remediation.objective: Assign an explicit governed account-level disposition after human review.
acceptance_criteria: The public repository has an explicit portfolio or account disposition.
Discovery did not automatically enrol or classify the repository.
verification: Run public-account discovery and portfolio validation.
